title: Parker
meta_description: Featuring a cozy fireplace and a guest house, Parker is a 5BR charming retreat perfect for groups! Emerald Coast doesn't get better than this.
description_expanded:
Welcome to Parker! Filled with natural light and coastal decor, this breezy home is just a short walk away from direct beach access (no shuttle needed). Nestled behind a gated community, enjoy a pool access, a miniature golf course, a playground, several parks, and beautiful tree-lined paths for biking or walking. With multiple porches, swings, benches, and plush furnishings, there's plenty of space to relax and connect with your group. For additional visitors or those looking for even more privacy, a guest house featuring a kitchenette offers the perfect sanctuary. When evening comes, congregate in one of the dining areas to bond over a meal and games. If you prefer to eat out and explore, check out some of the local spots inside the gates for dining, shopping, and entertainment. If you're looking for the perfect place for some rest and sunny beach days, you've found it at Parker!

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

Local Attractions: St. Andrews State Park, Camp Helen State Park, Ms. Newby's and Runaway Island (karaoke), Jimmy Buffett's Margaritaville, Pier Park, Gulf World Marine Park, Water Planet, Little Village Waterfront Shopping Market, SkyWheel, Shipwreck Island Waterpark.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure views, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

\*Home Truths:\*
- Bedroom 5 and its en-suite bathroom are located in the casita (guest house).
- Guests may not park boats or watercraft in the driveway or anywhere in public view. Violations will be ticketed.
- Per Watersound Beach Association regulations, guests are not permitted to use rental golf carts at this property.
- The miniature golf course is a two-minute walk from the house. Clubs and balls can be borrowed from the front gate/security office.
- Please note our occupancy includes an additional two beyond bed count. Trifold floor mattresses and additional linens can be provided upon request.
- The maximum number of vehicles which can park on-site: 2

Parking Details:
A maximum of 3 vehicles can park onsite.
On-street parking is prohibited. Please limit all parking of vehicles, trailers, RVs, etc to the space available on the property.

All bookings over 28 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.

Walton County TDT Registration Number: 21771
